name: Agent Board Integration and Autonomous Worker

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: '*/15 * * * *'

env:
  GITHUB_PROJECTS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_PROJECTS_TOKEN }}
  GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

jobs:
  agentic-kanban-worker:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write
      pull-requests: write
      repository-projects: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          cargo install --locked cargo-nextest
          cargo install --locked cargo-llvm-cov

      - name: Run Unit Tests
        run: |
          cargo nextest run --workspace
          cargo test --workspace

      - name: Run Integration Tests
        run: |
          cargo test --workspace --features integration-tests

      - name: Build Project
        run: |
          cargo build --release

      - name: Query Board for Unblocked Tasks
        id: query_tasks
        run: |
          echo "Querying board for unblocked TODO tasks..."
          # This would typically call the GraphQL API
          # For now, we'll simulate with a placeholder
          echo "task_count=0" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Claim Work Items
        if: steps.query_tasks.outputs.task_count > 0
        run: |
          echo "Claiming work items from board..."
          # Implementation would involve GraphQL mutations
          # to claim items using the board manager

      - name: Execute Agent Tasks
        if: steps.query_tasks.outputs.task_count > 0
        run: |
          echo "Executing agent tasks..."
          # This would trigger actual agent execution logic
          # Could include calling Claude Code API or other agents

      - name: Release Claimed Work
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo "Releasing claimed work items..."
          # Implementation would involve GraphQL mutations
          # to release items back to the board

      - name: Update Board Status
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo "Updating board with task completion status..."
          # Update board with task completion status
          # Move completed tasks to Done column

      - name: Notify Slack on Failure
        if: failure()
        uses: act10ns/slack@44541246747a30eb3102d87f7a4cc5471b0ffb7d
        with:
          webhook-url: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
          status: failure
          message: "Agent Kanban Worker failed at ${{ github.run_number }}"

      - name: Notify Slack on Success
        if: success()
        uses: act10ns/slack@44541246747a30eb3102d87f7a4cc5471b0ffb7d
        with:
          webhook-url: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
          status: success
          message: "Agent Kanban Worker completed successfully at ${{ github.run_number }}"

  board-integration-tests:
    needs: agentic-kanban-worker
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable

      - name: Run Board Integration Tests
        run: |
          cargo test --workspace --features board-integration-tests

      - name: Run Board Manager Tests
        run: |
          cargo test --workspace --features board-manager-tests

  security-audit:
    needs: [agentic-kanban-worker, board-integration-tests]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run Security Audit
        run: |
          cargo audit

  code-coverage:
    needs: [agentic-kanban-worker, board-integration-tests]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable

      - name: Generate Coverage Report
        run: |
          cargo llvm-cov --workspace --lcov --output-path lcov.info

      - name: Upload Coverage to Codecov
        uses: getsentry/codecov-action@fda17cfc37e16a0cc23f61685813390bfee7daf3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: lcov.info
          flags: unittests
          name: codecov-umbrella

  docker-build:
    needs: [agentic-kanban-worker, board-integration-tests]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Login to GitHub Container Registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Extract Metadata for Docker
        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@v5
        with:
          images: ghcr.io/${{ github.repository_owner }}/agent-board-integration

      - name: Build and Push Docker Image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: .
          push: true
          tags: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
          labels: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.labels }}
